extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper integration, Plex/Emby/Silo sources, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومصادر Plex وEmby وSilo وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add compatible Stremio manifests, browse provider catalogs, use native Plex, Emby/Jellyfin and Silo sources, play streams with external subtitles, link Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف روابط Stremio، واستخدم مصادر Plex وEmby/Jellyfin وSilo الأصلية، وشغّل الترجمات الخارجية، واربط Trakt، واستخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news: The playback capsule: once the picture runs a pill at the top shows Dex Hub's mark, the video (4K DV, and under it HEVC 10bit · 24.5 Mbps), the audio (Atmos, and under it TrueHD 7.1) and the age rating with the star rating; it stays a few seconds and fades, and comes again only for a new playback or another source. Its options are in the player options and on the phone setup page: on or off, the rating, the place (top left, centre or right) and how long (4, 6 or 10 seconds). The Parents Guide waits until it is gone. Needs skin 3.28.134.
